content: Solo iOS app timeline traps: (1) Scope creep happens in chunks, not all at once — a 'small' feature adds 2 weeks unnoticed. (2) Feature bloat: 80%+ of app features go unused; most 'brilliant ideas' don't contribute to MVP viability. (3) Context switching kills solo devs — dedicating blocks of time and noting ideas for later prevents rabbit holes. (4) New-idea syndrome: implementing new ideas mid-phase instead of logging them for later. (5) Underestimating App Store submission logistics (screenshots, metadata, privacy policy URL, TestFlight, 1-3 day review buffer). (6) HealthKit testing requiring real device often deferred too late, discovered issues too close to deadline.
